romantic.en: And I'm not even talking about romantic love necessarily, so be a little careful there.
romantic.zh: 我甚至不一定是指浪漫的爱情，所以在这点上要稍微注意一下。

romantic.en: And that is the human experience. I'm getting romantic about it because I think it's incredibly profound.
romantic.zh: 这就是人类的生活体验。我说得有点动情，是因为我觉得这一点极其深刻。

roam.en: In his twenties, he worked as a buffalo hunter on the Kansas plains, when the vast herds that had roamed the great plains for centuries were being systematically slaughtered for their hides.
roam.zh: 二十多岁时，他在堪萨斯平原上当过猎捕野牛的猎人，当时那些在大平原上漫游了几个世纪的庞大兽群，正被有计划地大批猎杀以获取兽皮。

roam.en: Our next stop takes us to the late 20th and early 21st centuries, where we find a new type of mercenary emerging—not roaming soldiers with lances, but organised, corporate entities offering military services for profit.
roam.zh: 我们的下一站将我们带到20世纪末和21世纪初，我们发现了一种新型雇佣兵的崛起——不再是带着长矛游荡的士兵，而是提供营利性军事服务的有组织的企业实体。

rob.en: It can rob you of insight, insight about how your own mind is changing.
rob.zh: 它会剥夺你的洞察力，让你对自己的思维如何发生变化失去洞察力。

rob.en: And when you get robbed of that because you get to play life in easy mode or.
rob.zh: 而当你因为以简单模式玩生活而被剥夺了这一点时，或者……

rob.en: And I was just telling my partner, Rob, about this.
rob.zh: 我刚才还在和我的合伙人Rob谈论这个。

rob.en: You replied to my friend, Rob Henderson, he was talking about how kids fall asleep more quickly when they're being carried.
rob.zh: 你回复了我的朋友Rob Henderson，他当时在谈论孩子们被抱着时入睡得更快。

rob.en: They robbed stagecoaches. They intimidated people.
rob.zh: 他们打劫驿马车，恐吓当地居民。

robbery.en: There, they were fingerprinted, photographed, and charged with offences like armed robbery.
robbery.zh: 在那里，他们被采集指纹、拍照，并被指控犯下持械抢劫之类的罪名。

robbery.en: A government that reduces jury rights for fraud and robbery has already won the argument in principle.
robbery.zh: 一个已经削减了诈骗和抢劫案陪审团权利的政府，实际上已经在原则层面赢得了这场争论。

robbery.en: The Courts and Tribunals Bill, which is working its way through Parliament as this episode is being recorded, would remove the rights of defendants to elect a jury trial for what are called “either-way offences” — things like fraud, robbery, and certain drug offences.
robbery.zh: 《法院与裁判庭法案》(Courts and Tribunals Bill)目前正在议会审议过程中——就在这期节目录制的同时——该法案将取消被告在所谓"可选审判方式罪行"上选择陪审团审判的权利，这类罪行包括诈骗、抢劫，以及某些毒品犯罪。

rocket.en: Liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen are the primary propellants of many modern rockets, so if water can be found on an asteroid, for example, it becomes incredibly valuable.
rocket.zh: 液氢和液氧是许多现代火箭的主要推进剂，所以如果在小行星上发现了水，它就会变得极其宝贵。

rocket.en: But the one who goes out and builds a hospital or builds a rocket to take people to the moon, you know, rescue some astronauts, you should be rewarding him for that.
rocket.zh: 但那个去建造医院或制造火箭把人们送上月球，你知道，营救宇航员的人，你应该为此奖励他。

rocket.en: If you need to build a settlement, it could be a lot more cost effective to take the raw materials from a nearby asteroid than shooting them up from a rocket on Earth.
rocket.zh: 如果你需要建立一个定居点，从附近的小行星获取原材料，要比用地球上的火箭发射成本划算得多。

rocket.en: But Elon Musk, even to his greatest critics, had an established track record of pushing through change that was thought to be impossible, whether it was Twitter, mass-market electric cars or reusable rockets.
rocket.zh: 但即便面对最严厉的批评者，Elon Musk 在强行推行被认为是不可能实现的变革方面也有着既定的记录，无论是 Twitter、大众市场电动汽车还是可回收火箭。

robe.en: Lawrence abandoned his British uniform, and instead dressed in flowing white robes like an Arab sheikh.
robe.zh: Lawrence 脱下了他的英国制服，换上了像阿拉伯酋长那样飘逸的白袍。

robe.en: It was partly practicality—the robes were more suited to the desert—but it was also a symbol.
robe.zh: 这部分是出于实用性——长袍更适合沙漠——但也是一种象征。

royalty.en: Theseus was a prince of Athens, but as a child he didn’t know he was royalty.
royalty.zh: 忒修斯是雅典的王子，但小时候他并不知道自己是皇室成员。

royalty.en: The food served to wealthy people and royalty was nothing like simple pottage eaten by ordinary people.
royalty.zh: 供富人和皇室享用的食物，与普通人吃的简单炖汤完全不同。

royalty.en: For centuries, a lot of Europe had been ruled by monarchs, kings, queens, emperors, princes, other kinds of royalty.
royalty.zh: 几个世纪以来，欧洲的许多地方一直由君主、国王、女王、皇帝、亲王和其他种类的皇室统治。

royalty.en: And by the 18th and 19th centuries, perfume was no longer just for royalty; it was for anyone who could afford it.
royalty.zh: 到了 18 世纪和 19 世纪，香水不再只是皇室的专利，它属于任何买得起的人。

rotation.en: Maybe this would be using thrusters to slow or stop its rotation.
rotation.zh: 也许这可以通过使用推进器来减缓或停止其旋转来实现。

rotation.en: Maybe it would be by using large nets or tethers to anchor it, or by synchronising mining tools to match the asteroid’s rotation.
rotation.zh: 也许可以通过使用大网或系绳来锚定它，或者通过同步采矿工具来配合小行星的旋转来实现。

roller.en: I’m the one … I go through that kind of emotional roller coaster with him.
roller.zh: 我就是那个……我和他一起经历那种情绪过山车的人。

roller.en: We like fight for it. Like the 40 minute queue is what makes us so grateful for the roller coaster.
roller.zh: 我们为它奋斗。就像40分钟的排队让我们对过山车如此感激。

roller.en: We're like, oh, we assumed that the theme park, we loved the theme park because of the roller coasters.
roller.zh: 我们想，哦，我们以为我们喜欢主题公园是因为过山车。

roller.en: And one of the things I love about this book, we hear his story, which is--to call it a roller coaster doesn't do justice to it.
roller.zh: 我特别喜欢这本书的一点是，我们能读到他的故事——说这是过山车都不足以形容它的跌宕起伏。

roundabout.en: And I think, I know that was a roundabout way of getting back to regrets, but he regretted how he had raised her.
roundabout.zh: 我想，我知道这是兜了个大圈子才又绕回“遗憾”这个话题，但他确实后悔自己当初是那样抚养她的。
